summary: Clean on SEC. All three modules are thin extern-ref wrappers over libc symbols that perform no numbox-side buffer length arithmetic, format-string parsing, SQL, path loading, or NUL handling. The only buffer-writing surface, strerror_safe(errnum, buf, buflen), hands the caller-owned buffer pointer and the caller-supplied length straight to a bounds-respecting libc routine (strerror_r / __xpg_strerror_r / strerror_s, all of which cap their write at buflen); buf/buflen are trusted by the documented raw-pointer contract. No findings.
